Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished Chinese WeChat mini program product design presentation for existing app FunBox 麻将记分. This is a proposed enhancement of existing functional pages, not an actual mahjong playing game. Wide landscape design board, high resolution 2560x1800, clean light ice blue canvas #f5f7fa. Four large readable mobile app screen mockups side by side, no device bezels, rounded panels, WeChat top nav and capsule. Editorial design typography, clear crisp Simplified Chinese, plenty of whitespace, tasteful small callouts beneath each screen with numbered blue badges and motion arrows. Existing visual language: cobalt blue #2d5bff CTAs and accents, white cards 16px radius, deep navy #172139 text, gray-blue secondary, coral red loss, green gains. Add selective jade green small tabletop areas, tactile porcelain white mahjong tiles with green backs, Chinese 東南西北 seat tiles, red 中 and green 發, matching a friendly softly rendered 3D ceramic illustration system. Precise modern functional UI, subtle shadows, charming but restrained, not casino, no gold coins, no poker chips, no gambling ads, no invented automatic scoring, dice must only decorate, no seat shuffle or game logic. Scoring is manually submitted by the payer, can pay multiple recipients once. Room names/password inline editable, invite QR bypasses password and asks nickname only. Amounts only appear at settlement. Keep numerical examples zero sum. Screens must be the majority of board, avoid long paragraphs. Show proposed motion as tasteful dotted trajectories and 2-3 ghost positions OUTSIDE input controls. Title Chinese, small eyebrow FUNBOX / MAHJONG EXPERIENCE / CONCEPT V1. Include small footer 概念设计 · 动效以轨迹示意. BOARD 01 title "把开一桌，变成一次入座" subtitle "01 / 入口 · 建房 · 加入 · 候场". Four main screens:
1 首页: FunBox blue wordmark, avatar guest chip; headline 好友相聚，每局都算数。hero white green-backed mahjong tiles red 中, blue +/- score tile, blue die only decorative. Main interactive scene card 麻将记分 / 4 人牌局 · 给分与结算 / 已开放, small faded 炸金花 敬请期待 card; tiny 3 scoring principles and bottom 首页 / 我的 tabs. Motion caption "入口牌轻抬 · 点击压下" 160ms.
2 创建房间 screen nav 麻将记分, hero 好友围桌，轻松记分 plus 3D tiles at upper right, segmented 创建房间 selected / 加入房间. White form 开一桌 / 4人局. 老友局 with pencil, note 名称、密码可点按修改. nickname input 小林; password 666666 inline pencil; info 先记分，散场时再设置金额. Large blue 创建房间 CTA with tile-like white rim. At bottom small four decorative green tile backs becoming a neat row. Caption "创建成功 · 四张牌铺成桌面" 320ms.
3 加入房间 screen nav 麻将记分, segmented 创建房间 / 加入房间 selected. Large centered white card with 3D green-backed mahjong invitation tile with QR scan brackets. 扫一扫，加入好友牌局 / 扫描房主出示的房间邀请码. Blue 扫码加入. White row 输入房间码加入 ›. Footer 游客也可加入，无需注册. Below board screen, small inset detail for manual-code sheet showing six white mahjong-shaped cells 6 8 2 9 1 5 and 房间密码 / 你的昵称, label 手动加入：数字逐格落牌（输入仍支持粘贴）. QR is illustrative.
4 房间等待 screen nav 麻将牌局; 老友局 / 牌桌 682915 with green 实时同步 chip, 3/4 等待开始. Compact jade green rounded tabletop with four portrait rectangular white seat tiles spatially arranged, 東 小林 我 房主; 南 阿杰 已入座; 西 小雨 已入座; 北 green tile back + 等你入座, no invented game hands. Invitation block white QR on right with large room code 682915 left, copy 房间密码 666666 and button 发送邀请给牌友, bottom disabled 等待牌友加入. Motion annotation "有人加入：牌背翻为昵称 · 280ms". Beneath in tiny supporting inset invitation-confirm card 老友局 / 邀请已验证 / nickname input / 确认加入, label 邀请确认沿用同一张入座牌.
Keep all screen content coherent, no random English UI. Four screens equal 390x900 logical dimensions. Under each 1-2 concise Chinese motion notes, use board margins generously. This board should look like a real premium product team's final design exploration.

1 Active room nav 麻将牌局, header 老友局 / 牌桌 682915 / green 实时同步. Compact jade-tinted score area titled 牌桌积分榜 with four horizontal readable rows white porcelain small seat tiles and scores: 東 小林 我 +48; 南 阿杰 +16; 西 小雨 −24; 北 阿北 −40. Keep list efficient. White card 这局怎么给 / 赢家无需填写, recipient input rows 阿杰 [8] 分 ; 小雨 [0] 分 ; 阿北 [0] 分. Total 本次给出 8 分. Big blue 确认给分. Bottom 牌桌记事 two small lines and low-emphasis 散场结算. At screen edge show a proposed AFTER-success motion overlay short blue/green tally sticks flying from self tile to 阿杰 seat with dotted blue curve and small transient "给分成功" chip, without covering inputs. Motion caption "成功后记分棒飞向牌友 · 分数滚动" 350ms; note 输入区保持稳定. No currency on this screen.
2 Settlement confirmation screen shows darkened active background and bottom sheet tall enough for all four rows. Sheet like porcelain tile with top jade thin edge and handle; title 确认结算 subtitle 请核对分数与预计金额. 每分金额 [¥ 1] 元/分. Table 牌友 / 当前分数 / 预计金额, 小林 +48 +¥48.00; 阿杰 +16 +¥16.00; 小雨 −24 −¥24.00; 阿北 −40 −¥40.00. Muted coral warning 结算后不可修改，请再次确认。Blue main 确认并结算 and secondary 取消. Annotation "四张记分牌收拢为账单 · 300ms" keep serious readable confirmation no confetti.
3 Settled result nav 牌局结算. Hero small arranged closed green-backed mahjong tiles and a white receipt with cobalt checkmark, headline 这桌，散场了 / 输赢已理清. White final results list 小林 +48分 +¥48.00, 阿杰 +16分 +¥16.00, 小雨 −24分 −¥24.00, 阿北 −40分 −¥40.00. Lower 转账建议 card with clear exact transfers 小雨 → 小林 ¥24.00; 阿北 → 小林 ¥24.00; 阿北 → 阿杰 ¥16.00. Label 转账建议 not actual payment. Bottom 返回首页. Motion caption "收牌后展开账单 · 仅首次进入播放". Small modest jade line flourish, no big celebration.
4 History page nav 最近牌局. Elegant 3D upright 東 tile and small blue ledger at upper right. Header 每一桌，都有记录 and tiny FunBox / 牌局记录. Time range chips 全部 / 近7天 / 近30天 / 近90天 with 全部 selected. White roomy records resembling neat archived mahjong scorecards with slim jade left edge and little mahjong tile icon: 老友局 / 麻将 / +48分 / +¥48.00; 参与者 小林、阿杰、小雨、阿北; 结算时间 2026-10-30 21:30. Second 周末小聚 −12分 −¥12.00 with prior date. Bottom 第1/3页 · 共12场 / 上一页 下一页. No fake achievements statistics win rates or replay buttons. Caption "记录卡逐张入列 · 轻触反馈" 180ms. Supporting tiny bottom strip three loading tile backs with ghost flip progression and note 加载：三张牌依次翻面；离线：保留分数，显示重连；减少动态：静态替代.
Make visually match BOARD 01: icy blue backgrounds cobalt CTA, porcelain white tiles jade sides coral small details; editorial margins, clear Chinese functional text.
